research_attempts.query_text: Gould M. Cassal: visually checked NARA index and exact private-identifier Army match; official documentation and occupation code; public NARA context; CIA Reading Room; LoC current API context; exact-name OSS, Bessie Beatty, WOR, employment, obituary, directory, newspaper, and archival searches.
research_attempts.rejection_reasons: Postwar CIA and music-industry records were identity context only; they do not establish pre-OSS employment. The contemporary reports do not identify the legal employer or the Army-to-OSS transfer.
research_attempts.research_notes: Two contemporary trade reports and the exact Army record support a last civilian role on Bessie Beatty's WOR program. Immediate pre-OSS affiliation remains unknown.
research_attempts.next_action: Review Box 112 for the legal employer and Army-to-OSS chronology.
